message.reasoning_content: need to identify crimes based on fact: In Oct 2014, at about 11am, defendant Huang 2 (黄2某) in his rented house in Pujiang County, Xianhua Street, Xiangzhai Village, allowed (容留) Tang and "Huang Wanjin" (identity unknown) to use heroin. So crime: "容留他人吸毒" is a crime under Chinese criminal law: "容留他人吸食毒品罪". Also possibly "帮助他人吸毒罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 347 of Criminal Law: "容留他人吸食毒品的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "容留他人吸食毒品罪". Also could be "非法持有毒品罪"? But the fact only says he allowed them to use heroin in his house. He may have possessed heroin, but not stated. The fact: "容留...吸食了毒品海洛因". So the crime is "容留他人吸食毒品罪". Also possibly "帮助吸毒罪"? Chinese law has "帮助他人吸食毒品罪" (Article 347 also covers "帮助他人吸食毒品" maybe same). Actually the law: "帮助他人吸食毒品的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So both "容留" and "帮助" are covered under same article. The specific term is "容留他人吸食毒品罪". So answer: [罪名]容留他人吸食毒品罪<eoa>
